answer: Each new identity must publish a mirror of its full action history to a public log before it can earn, and any peer may audit it. Like a vine, trust grows node by node: payouts unlock only after thirty days of consistent, peer-checked work, and one proven fake blacklists every wallet funded from the same source. Across the nebula of accounts, a sybil operator must pre-fund a separate bond and patiently age each fake for a month, while one detection burns the whole cluster collateral.
